title: Prohibit Rng Callback State In Ops
forbids: RngFunction, options.rng, and ctx.rng in domain ops
why: Every domain operation is deterministic over its admitted input and strategy configuration, regardless of whether it lives directly under a domain or inside a semantic module. Ambient RNG callbacks or context state create a hidden execution input outside that contract.
remediate: Derive and pass the operation's deterministic seed as explicit input data; do not close over RNG callbacks or read RNG state from options or context.
message: Do not use RNG callback/state surfaces inside domain ops.
